            queryset = queryset.filter(list_type=list_type)

        # Optional trip filter
        trip_id = self.request.query_params.get("trip_id")
        if trip_id:
            if trip_id == "none":
                # Get standalone lists only
                queryset = queryset.filter(trip__isnull=True)
            else:
                queryset = queryset.filter(trip_id=trip_id)

        # Include trip-only items filter
        show_trip_only = self.request.query_params.get("show_trip_only", "true")
        if show_trip_only.lower() == "false":
            # Exclude items marked as trip_only when not viewing in trip context
            queryset = queryset.prefetch_related(
                "items"  # Will filter in serializer if needed
            )

        visible_items = Prefetch(
            "items",
            queryset=mobile_visible_item_queryset(
                GroceryItem.objects.select_related(
                    "planned_store",
                    "assigned_to",
                    "created_by",
                    "category",
                    "grocery_category",
                    "product_preference",
                )
                .prefetch_related("labels")
                .order_by("position")
            ),
        )

        return queryset.select_related("owner", "family", "trip").prefetch_related(
            visible_items
        )

    def list(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """List grocery lists, auto-creating 'Open Items' if needed."""
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            try:
                family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(id=family_id)
                if FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                    user=request.user, family=family, is_active=True
                ).exists():
                    GroceryList.ensure_open_items_list(family, owner=request.user)
            except FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist:
                pass
        return super().list(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def perform_create(self, serializer: Any) -> None:
        """Create a grocery list with the current user as owner."""
        with transaction.atomic():
            grocery_list = serializer.save(owner=self.request.user)
            logger.info(
                "Created grocery list %s for family %s by user %s",
                grocery_list.id,
                grocery_list.family_id,
                self.request.user.id,
            )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_list.create",
            outcome="success",
        )

        from family_scheduler.tracking.client import (
            TrackingEventDetails,
            get_tracking_client,
        )

        get_tracking_client().track(
            "grocery_list_created",
            distinct_id=str(self.request.user.id),
            details=TrackingEventDetails(
                data={
                    "family_id": str(grocery_list.family_id),
                }
            ),
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def clear_completed(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Remove all completed items from the list."""
        grocery_list = self.get_object()
        deleted_count = grocery_list.items.filter(is_completed=True).delete()[0]
        return Response(
            {
                "deleted_count": deleted_count,
                "message": f"Removed {deleted_count} completed items",
            }
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def duplicate(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Duplicate this grocery list (without completed items)."""
        original = self.get_object()

        with transaction.atomic():
            # Create new list
            new_list = GroceryList.objects.create(
                family=original.family,
                trip=None,  # Don't link duplicate to trip
                name=f"{original.name} (Copy)",
                description=original.description,
                list_type=original.list_type,
                is_group=original.is_group,
                owner=request.user,
            )

            # Copy incomplete items preserving order
            for item in original.items.filter(is_completed=False).order_by("position"):
                GroceryItem.objects.create(
                    grocery_list=new_list,
                    name=item.name,
                    description=item.description,
                    quantity=item.quantity,
                    unit=item.unit,
                    weight_amount=item.weight_amount,
                    weight_unit=item.weight_unit,
                    position=item.position,
                    category=item.category,
                    grocery_category=item.grocery_category,
                    trip_only=item.trip_only,
                    created_by=request.user,
                )

        serializer = GroceryListSerializer(new_list)
        return Response(serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def reset_for_new_week(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Reset a list for a new week: save items to history, then clear the list.

        Accepts an optional ``carry_over_item_ids`` list in the request body.
        When provided, only items **not** in the list are deleted; carried-over
        items have ``is_completed`` reset to ``False`` and positions renumbered.
        When omitted (or ``None``), all items are deleted (legacy behaviour).
        """
        grocery_list = self.get_object()
        items = list(grocery_list.items.all().order_by("position"))

        # --- validate optional carry_over_item_ids -----------------------
        carry_over_item_ids = request.data.get("carry_over_item_ids")
        if carry_over_item_ids is not None:
            if not isinstance(carry_over_item_ids, list):
                return Response(
                    {"error": "carry_over_item_ids must be a list."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
            if not all(isinstance(i, int) for i in carry_over_item_ids):
                return Response(
                    {"error": "All carry_over_item_ids must be integers."},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
            list_item_ids = {item.id for item in items}
            invalid_ids = set(carry_over_item_ids) - list_item_ids
            if invalid_ids:
                return Response(
                    {"error": f"IDs not on this list: {sorted(invalid_ids)}"},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )
            carry_over_set: set[int] | None = set(carry_over_item_ids)
        else:
            carry_over_set = None

        with transaction.atomic():
            # Save ALL items to history (regardless of carry-over)
            save_items_to_history(grocery_list, items)

            if carry_over_set is not None:
                # Delete items NOT in the carry-over set
                deleted_count = grocery_list.items.exclude(
                    id__in=carry_over_set
                ).delete()[0]
                # Reset carried-over items and renumber positions
                carried_items = list(
                    grocery_list.items.filter(id__in=carry_over_set).order_by(
                        "position"
                    )
                )
                for pos, item in enumerate(carried_items):
                    item.is_completed = False
                    item.position = pos
                GroceryItem.objects.bulk_update(
                    carried_items, ["is_completed", "position"]
                )
                items_carried_over = len(carried_items)
            else:
                # Legacy behaviour: delete everything
                deleted_count = grocery_list.items.all().delete()[0]
                items_carried_over = 0

        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_list.reset_for_new_week",
            outcome="success",
        )

        suggestion_count = ListItemHistory.objects.filter(
            grocery_list=grocery_list
        ).count()

        return Response(
            {
                "items_saved": len(items),
                "items_deleted": deleted_count,
                "items_carried_over": items_carried_over,
                "suggestion_count": suggestion_count,
                "message": f"Saved {len(items)} items to history",
            }
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["get"])
    def suggestions(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Get item suggestions from history for rebuilding a list."""
        grocery_list = self.get_object()
        scope = request.query_params.get("scope", "this_list")

        if scope == "all_lists":
            history = ListItemHistory.objects.filter(
                family=grocery_list.family
            ).select_related("grocery_list", "grocery_category", "planned_store")
        else:
            history = ListItemHistory.objects.filter(
                grocery_list=grocery_list
            ).select_related("grocery_category", "planned_store")

        data = []
        for h in history[:50]:  # Limit to 50 suggestions
            entry = {
                "id": str(h.id),
                "name": h.name,
                "quantity": h.quantity,
                "unit": h.unit,
                "weight_amount": str(h.weight_amount) if h.weight_amount else None,
                "weight_unit": h.weight_unit,
                "times_added": h.times_added,
                "last_added_at": h.last_added_at.isoformat(),
                "grocery_category": str(h.grocery_category_id)
                if h.grocery_category_id
                else None,
                "planned_store": str(h.planned_store_id)
                if h.planned_store_id
                else None,
            }
            if scope == "all_lists" and h.grocery_list:
                entry["source_list_name"] = h.grocery_list.name
                entry["source_list_id"] = str(h.grocery_list.id)
            data.append(entry)

        return Response(data)


class GroceryItemViewSet(FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet[GroceryItem]):
    """
    ViewSet for managing grocery items.

    Provides CRUD operations for grocery items with family-based access control.
    """

    required_feature = "groceries"
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get_serializer_class(self) -> Any:
        if self.action == "create":
            return GroceryItemCreateSerializer
        return GroceryItemSerializer

    def get_queryset(self) -> Any:
        """Get grocery items for the current user's families."""
        user = self.request.user

        user_family_ids = list(
            FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True).values_list(  # type: ignore[misc]
                "family_id", flat=True
            )
        )

        if not user_family_ids:
            return GroceryItem.objects.none()

        queryset = GroceryItem.objects.filter(
            grocery_list__family_id__in=user_family_ids
        )

        # Optional list filter
        list_id = self.request.query_params.get("grocery_list")
        if list_id:
            try:
                queryset = queryset.filter(grocery_list_id=UUID(list_id))
            except ValueError:
                return queryset.none()

        # Optional completion filter
        is_completed = self.request.query_params.get("is_completed")
        if is_completed is not None:
            queryset = queryset.filter(is_completed=is_completed.lower() == "true")

        # Optional trip_only filter
        trip_only = self.request.query_params.get("trip_only")
        if trip_only is not None:
            queryset = queryset.filter(trip_only=trip_only.lower() == "true")

        return queryset.select_related(
            "grocery_list",
            "grocery_list__family",
            "assigned_to",
            "created_by",
            "category",
            "grocery_category",
        ).prefetch_related("labels")

    def perform_create(self, serializer: Any) -> Any:
        """Create a grocery item with the current user as creator and auto-assigned position."""
        grocery_list = serializer.validated_data["grocery_list"]

        # Defense-in-depth: reject creates targeting a list outside the
        # user's family memberships. The serializer's validate_grocery_list
        # is the primary gate; this guard ensures the invariant holds even
        # if a future serializer subclass forgets to enforce it.
        user_family_ids = set(
            FamilyMembership.objects.filter(  # type: ignore[misc]
                user=self.request.user, is_active=True
            ).values_list("family_id", flat=True)
        )
        if grocery_list.family_id not in user_family_ids:
            logger.warning(
                "Cross-family grocery item create blocked: user=%s list=%s list_family=%s",
                self.request.user.id,
                grocery_list.id,
                grocery_list.family_id,
            )
            raise PermissionDenied("You do not have access to this grocery list.")

        max_position = (
            GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list=grocery_list).aggregate(
                max_pos=models.Max("position")
            )["max_pos"]
            or -1
        )
        item = serializer.save(
            created_by=self.request.user,
            position=max_position + 1,
        )
        logger.info(
            "Created grocery item %s in list %s by user %s",
            item.id,
            item.grocery_list_id,
            self.request.user.id,
        )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.create",
            outcome="success",
            item_id=str(item.id),
        )

    def create(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Create a grocery item and return full serialized response."""
        serializer = self.get_serializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_create(serializer)

        # Return full response using GroceryItemSerializer
        response_serializer = GroceryItemSerializer(
            serializer.instance, context=self.get_serializer_context()
        )
        headers = self.get_success_headers(response_serializer.data)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="grocery_item.create",
            outcome="success",
            item_id=str(serializer.instance.id) if serializer.instance else "",
        )
        return Response(
            response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, headers=headers
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def toggle(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Toggle the completion status of an item."""
        item = self.get_object()
        new_status = item.toggle_completed()
        return Response(
            {
                "id": item.id,
                "is_completed": new_status,
                "completed_at": item.completed_at.isoformat()
                if item.completed_at
                else None,
            }
        )

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"])
    def bulk_toggle(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        """Toggle completion status for multiple items."""
        item_ids = request.data.get("item_ids", [])
        if not item_ids:
            return Response(
                {"error": "item_ids is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        items = self.get_queryset().filter(id__in=item_ids)
        updated = []
        for item in items:
            item.toggle_completed()
            updated.append(
                {
                    "id": item.id,
                    "is_completed": item.is_completed,
                    "completed_at": item.completed_at.isoformat()
                    if item.completed_at
                    else None,
                }
            )

        return Response({"updated": updated})

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"])
    def reorder(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        """Reorder items within a grocery list."""
        item_ids = request.data.get("item_ids", [])
        grocery_list_id = request.data.get("grocery_list")
        if not item_ids or not grocery_list_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "item_ids and grocery_list are required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        try:
            grocery_list = GroceryList.objects.select_related("family").get(
                id=grocery_list_id
            )
        except GroceryList.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Grocery list not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family=grocery_list.family,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        with transaction.atomic():
            for idx, item_id in enumerate(item_ids):
                self.get_queryset().filter(
                    id=item_id, grocery_list=grocery_list
                ).update(position=idx)

        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.reorder",
            outcome="success",
        )
        return Response({"message": f"Reordered {len(item_ids)} items"})

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"])
    def sort(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        """Sort items alphabetically within a grocery list (explicit user action)."""
        grocery_list_id = request.data.get("grocery_list")
        if not grocery_list_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "grocery_list is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        items = list(
            self.get_queryset()
            .filter(grocery_list_id=grocery_list_id)
            .order_by("name")
            .values_list("id", flat=True)
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            for idx, item_id in enumerate(items):
                GroceryItem.objects.filter(id=item_id).update(position=idx)

        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.sort",
            outcome="success",
        )
        return Response({"message": f"Sorted {len(items)} items alphabetically"})

    @action(detail=False, methods=["post"])
    def quick_add_from_suggestion(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        """Create a grocery item from a history suggestion."""
        history_id = request.data.get("history_id")
        grocery_list_id = request.data.get("grocery_list")

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family=grocery_list.family,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},

        )

        )

        )
        return Response(

            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def copy_to_list(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Copy this item to another grocery list."""
        item = self.get_object()
        target_list_id = request.data.get("target_list_id")
        if not target_list_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "target_list_id is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        try:
            target_list = GroceryList.objects.get(id=target_list_id)
        except GroceryList.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Target list not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        # Verify same family
        if target_list.family_id != item.grocery_list.family_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Cannot copy to a list in a different family"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        max_position = (
            GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list=target_list).aggregate(
                max_pos=models.Max("position")
            )["max_pos"]
            or -1
        )
        new_item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
            grocery_list=target_list,
            name=item.name,
            description=item.description,
            quantity=item.quantity,
            unit=item.unit,
            weight_amount=item.weight_amount,
            weight_unit=item.weight_unit,
            category=item.category,
            grocery_category=_category_for_target_list(
                item.grocery_category, target_list
            ),
            planned_store=item.planned_store,
            trip_only=item.trip_only,
            position=max_position + 1,
            created_by=request.user,
        )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.copy_to_list",
            outcome="success",
        )
        return Response(
            GroceryItemSerializer(new_item).data,
            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def move_to_list(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Move this item to another grocery list."""
        item = self.get_object()
        target_list_id = request.data.get("target_list_id")
        if not target_list_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "target_list_id is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        try:
            target_list = GroceryList.objects.get(id=target_list_id)
        except GroceryList.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Target list not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        if target_list.family_id != item.grocery_list.family_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Cannot move to a list in a different family"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        max_position = (
            GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list=target_list).aggregate(
                max_pos=models.Max("position")
            )["max_pos"]
            or -1
        )
        item.grocery_list = target_list
        item.grocery_category = _category_for_target_list(
            item.grocery_category, target_list
        )
        item.position = max_position + 1
        item.save(
            update_fields=["grocery_list", "grocery_category", "position", "updated_at"]
        )

        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_item.move_to_list",
            outcome="success",
        )
        return Response(GroceryItemSerializer(item).data)


class GroceryStoreViewSet(FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ViewSet):
    """ViewSet for family grocery stores (canonical + alias-backed)."""

    required_feature = "groceries"

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def list(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if not family_id:
            return Response([])

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family_id=family_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        stores = GroceryStore.objects.filter(
            family_id=family_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).order_by("name")
        serializer = GroceryStoreSerializer(stores, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)

    def create(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        serializer = GroceryStoreCreateSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        family_id = serializer.validated_data["family"]
        raw_name = serializer.validated_data["name"]

        try:
            family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(id=family_id)
        except FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Family not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family=family,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        from .services import GroceryStoreResolverService

        store, created = GroceryStoreResolverService.resolve_or_create_store(
            family=family,
            raw_name=raw_name,
            user=request.user,
            allow_create=True,
        )
        output = GroceryStoreSerializer(store)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="grocery_store.create",
            outcome="success",
            store_id=str(store.id),
        )
        return Response(
            output.data,
            status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED if created else status.HTTP_200_OK,
        )


class GroceryCategoryViewSet(
    FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet[GroceryCategory]
):
    """
    ViewSet for managing family-scoped grocery categories.

    On list, auto-creates default categories for the family if none exist.
    """

    required_feature = "groceries"

    serializer_class = GroceryCategorySerializer
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get_queryset(self) -> Any:
        user = self.request.user
        user_family_ids = list(
            FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True).values_list(  # type: ignore[misc]
                "family_id", flat=True
            )
        )
        if not user_family_ids:
            return GroceryCategory.objects.none()

        queryset = GroceryCategory.objects.filter(family_id__in=user_family_ids)

        family_id = self.request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=family_id)  # type: ignore[misc]

        list_type = self.request.query_params.get("list_type")
        if list_type:
            queryset = queryset.filter(list_type=list_type)

        return queryset

    def list(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """List categories, auto-creating defaults if needed."""
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        list_type = request.query_params.get("list_type")
        if family_id:
            user_id = request.user.id
            if user_id is None:
                return Response(
                    {"error": "Authentication required"},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                )

            if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
                user_id=user_id,
                family_id=family_id,
                is_active=True,
            ).exists():
                return Response(
                    {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                    status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                )
            try:
                family = FamilyGroup.objects.get(id=family_id)
                if list_type:
                    GroceryCategory.ensure_defaults_for_family(
                        family, list_type=list_type
                    )
            except FamilyGroup.DoesNotExist:
                return Response(
                    {"error": "Family not found"},
                    status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                )
        return super().list(request, *args, **kwargs)

    def update(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Disallow moving categories across families."""
        instance = self.get_object()
        if "family" in request.data and str(request.data["family"]) != str(
            instance.family_id
        ):
            return Response(
                {"error": "family cannot be changed"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )
        response = super().update(request, *args, **kwargs)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="grocery_category.update",
            outcome="success",
            category_id=str(instance.id),
        )
        return response

    def perform_create(self, serializer: Any) -> Any:
        family = serializer.validated_data["family"]
        user_id = self.request.user.id
        if user_id is None:
            raise PermissionDenied("Authentication required")

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user_id=user_id,
            family=family,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            raise PermissionDenied("You are not a member of this family")

        serializer.save(created_by=self.request.user)
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_category.create",
            outcome="success",
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance: Any) -> None:
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_category.delete",
            outcome="success",
        )
        instance.delete()


class AggregateGroceryListView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    Read-only aggregate view of all grocery items across all lists for a family.

    Returns items with store chip labels for the aggregate view.
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if not family_id:
            return Response(
                {"error": "family query parameter is required"},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user,
            family_id=family_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        items = (
            mobile_visible_item_queryset(
                GroceryItem.objects.filter(grocery_list__family_id=family_id)
            )
            .select_related(
                "grocery_list",
                "grocery_list__store",
                "planned_store",
                "category",
                "grocery_category",
                "assigned_to",
                "created_by",
            )
            .prefetch_related("labels")
            .order_by("grocery_list__name", "position")
        )

        data = []
        for item in items:
            item_data = GroceryItemSerializer(item).data
            # Add aggregate-specific fields
            item_data["list_name"] = item.grocery_list.name
            item_data["list_id"] = str(item.grocery_list.id)
            # Store chip: prefer planned_store > list store > list name
            if item.planned_store:
                item_data["store_chip_label"] = item.planned_store.name
            elif item.grocery_list.store:
                item_data["store_chip_label"] = item.grocery_list.store.name
            else:
                item_data["store_chip_label"] = item.grocery_list.name
            data.append(item_data)

        return Response(data)


class ActiveTripContextView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    View to get the active trip context for a family.

    Returns the currently active trip (if any) and whether it has a grocery list.
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")
        if not family_id:
            return Response({"trip": None, "has_grocery_list": False})

        # Match the list endpoint's non-explosive behavior when the client
        # holds an inaccessible family context.
        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user, family_id=family_id, is_active=True
        ).exists():
            return Response({"trip": None, "has_grocery_list": False})

        # Find active trip (current date falls within trip dates)
        from trips.models import Trip

        today = timezone.now().date()
        active_trip = (
            Trip.objects.filter(
                tripfamilygroups__familygroup_id=family_id,
                tripfamilygroups__status=TripFamilyGroups.STATUS_ACCEPTED,
                start_date__lte=today,
                end_date__gte=today,
                deleted_at__isnull=True,
            )
            .distinct()
            .first()
        )

        if active_trip:
            # Check if trip has a grocery list in new system
            has_list = GroceryList.objects.filter(
                family_id=family_id, trip=active_trip
            ).exists()

            serializer = ActiveTripContextSerializer(
                {"trip": active_trip, "has_grocery_list": has_list}
            )
            return Response(serializer.data)

        return Response({"trip": None, "has_grocery_list": False})


class FamilyProductPreferenceViewSet(
    FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet[FamilyProductPreference]
):
    """
    ViewSet for managing family product preferences.

    Provides CRUD operations for product preferences with family-based access control.
    Includes actions for managing brands and photos.
    """

    required_feature = "groceries"
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get_serializer_class(self) -> Any:
        if self.action == "create":
            return FamilyProductPreferenceCreateSerializer
        if self.action == "list":
            return FamilyProductPreferenceSummarySerializer
        return FamilyProductPreferenceSerializer

    def create(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        """Create a product preference and return full serialized response."""
        serializer = self.get_serializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_create(serializer)

        # Return full response using FamilyProductPreferenceSerializer
        response_serializer = FamilyProductPreferenceSerializer(
            serializer.instance, context=self.get_serializer_context()
        )
        headers = self.get_success_headers(response_serializer.data)
        record_wide_event(
            request=request,
            operation="product_preference.create",
            outcome="success",
            preference_id=str(serializer.instance.id) if serializer.instance else "",
        )
        return Response(
            response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, headers=headers
        )

    def get_queryset(self) -> Any:
        """Get product preferences for the current user's families."""
        user = self.request.user

        user_family_ids = list(
            FamilyMembership.objects.filter(user=user, is_active=True).values_list(  # type: ignore[misc]
                "family_id", flat=True
            )
        )

        if not user_family_ids:
            return FamilyProductPreference.objects.none()

        queryset = FamilyProductPreference.objects.filter(
            family_id__in=user_family_ids, is_active=True
        )

        # Optional family filter
        family_id = self.request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=family_id)  # type: ignore[misc]

        # Optional category filter
        category_id = self.request.query_params.get("category")
        if category_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(category_id=category_id)  # type: ignore[misc]

        # Optional search filter
        search = self.request.query_params.get("search")
        if search:
            queryset = queryset.filter(
                Q(product_name__icontains=search) | Q(brands__name__icontains=search)
            ).distinct()

        return queryset.select_related(
            "family", "category", "created_by"
        ).prefetch_related("brands", "photos")

    def perform_create(self, serializer: Any) -> None:
        """Create a product preference with the current user as creator."""
        with transaction.atomic():
            preference = serializer.save(created_by=self.request.user)
            logger.info(
                "Created product preference %s for family %s by user %s",
                preference.id,
                preference.family_id,
                self.request.user.id,
            )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="product_preference.create",
            outcome="success",
            preference_id=str(preference.id),
        )

    def perform_destroy(self, instance: Any) -> None:
        """Soft delete the product preference."""
        instance.is_active = False
        instance.save(update_fields=["is_active", "updated_at"])
        logger.info(
            "Soft-deleted product preference %s by user %s",
            instance.id,
            self.request.user.id,
        )
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="product_preference.destroy",
            outcome="success",
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def upload_photo(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Register a photo URL after S3 upload."""
        preference = self.get_object()
        photo_url = request.data.get("photo_url")

        if not photo_url:
            return Response(
                {"error": "photo_url is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        photo = ProductPreferencePhoto.objects.create(
            product_preference=preference,
            photo_url=photo_url,
            uploaded_by=request.user,
        )

        serializer = ProductPreferencePhotoSerializer(photo)
        return Response(serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["delete"], url_path="photos/(?P<photo_id>[^/.]+)")
    def delete_photo(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None, photo_id: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Delete a photo from the preference."""
        preference = self.get_object()

        try:
            photo = preference.photos.get(id=photo_id)
            photo.delete()
            return Response(status=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
        except ProductPreferencePhoto.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Photo not found"}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
            )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def add_brand(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Add a new brand to the preference with auto-ordering."""
        preference = self.get_object()
        name = request.data.get("name")

        if not name:
            return Response(
                {"error": "name is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        # Get next order number
        from django.db import models as db_models

        max_order = (
            preference.brands.aggregate(max_order=db_models.Max("preference_order"))[
                "max_order"
            ]
            or 0
        )

        brand = ProductBrand.objects.create(
            product_preference=preference,
            name=name,
            preference_order=max_order + 1,
            notes=request.data.get("notes", ""),
        )

        serializer = ProductBrandSerializer(brand)
        return Response(serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def reorder_brands(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Update the order of brands."""
        preference = self.get_object()
        brand_order = request.data.get("brand_order", [])

        if not brand_order:
            return Response(
                {"error": "brand_order is required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST
            )

        with transaction.atomic():
            for order, brand_id in enumerate(brand_order, start=1):
                preference.brands.filter(id=brand_id).update(preference_order=order)

        return Response({"message": "Brands reordered successfully"})

    @action(detail=True, methods=["delete"], url_path="brands/(?P<brand_id>[^/.]+)")
    def delete_brand(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None, brand_id: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        """Delete a brand from the preference."""
        preference = self.get_object()

        try:
            brand = preference.brands.get(id=brand_id)
            brand.delete()
            return Response(status=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
        except ProductBrand.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Brand not found"}, status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND
            )

    @action(detail=False, methods=["get"])
    def search(self, request: Any) -> Any:
        """Search product preferences by name for autocomplete."""
        query = request.query_params.get("q", "")
        family_id = request.query_params.get("family")

        if not query or len(query) < 2:
            return Response([])

        queryset = self.get_queryset()

        if family_id:
            queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=family_id)

        results = queryset.filter(product_name__icontains=query)[:10]

        serializer = FamilyProductPreferenceSummarySerializer(results, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)


class GroceryReceiptCaptureViewSet(

):

    required_feature = "groceries"
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get_serializer_class(self) -> Any:
        if self.action == "create":
            return GroceryReceiptCaptureCreateSerializer
        return GroceryReceiptCaptureSerializer

    def get_queryset(self) -> Any:
        family_ids = _accessible_family_ids(self.request.user)
        if not family_ids:
            return GroceryReceiptCapture.objects.none()

        queryset = GroceryReceiptCapture.objects.filter(family_id__in=family_ids)
        family_id = self.request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            try:
                queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=UUID(family_id))
            except ValueError:
                return queryset.none()

        parse_status = self.request.query_params.get("parse_status")
        if parse_status:
            queryset = queryset.filter(parse_status=parse_status)

        base = queryset.select_related("family", "uploaded_by")
        if self.action in ("retrieve", "parse", "apply"):
            return base.prefetch_related(
                "lines__candidate_matches__product_preference",
                "lines__matched_product_preference__grocery_category",
            )
        return base

    def create(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        serializer = self.get_serializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        self.perform_create(serializer)
        output = GroceryReceiptCaptureSerializer(
            serializer.instance,
            context=self.get_serializer_context(),
        )
        headers = self.get_success_headers(output.data)
        return Response(output.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, headers=headers)

    def perform_create(self, serializer: Any) -> None:
        family = serializer.validated_data["family"]
        _assert_family_access(self.request.user, family.id)
        capture = serializer.save(uploaded_by=self.request.user)
        record_wide_event(
            request=self.request,
            operation="grocery_receipt_capture.create",
            outcome="success",
            capture_id=str(capture.id),
        )

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def parse(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        capture = self.get_object()
        if capture.parse_status == GroceryReceiptCapture.ParseStatus.PROCESSING:
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Parsing already in progress."},
                status=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            )
        capture.parse_status = GroceryReceiptCapture.ParseStatus.PROCESSING
        capture.error_message = ""
        capture.save(update_fields=["parse_status", "error_message", "updated_at"])

        from .tasks import process_receipt_capture

        transaction.on_commit(lambda: process_receipt_capture.delay(str(capture.id)))
        serializer = GroceryReceiptCaptureSerializer(
            capture,
            context=self.get_serializer_context(),
        )
        return Response(serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED)

    @action(detail=True, methods=["post"])
    def apply(self, request: Any, pk: Any = None) -> Any:  # noqa: ARG002
        capture = self.get_object()
        serializer = ReceiptApplySerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        lines = [
            ReceiptApplyLine(**line_payload)
            for line_payload in serializer.validated_data["lines"]
        ]
        try:
            result = ReceiptApplyService.apply_capture(
                capture,
                user=request.user,
                lines=lines,
            )
        except (FamilyProductPreference.DoesNotExist, ValueError) as exc:
            logger.warning("Receipt apply failed for capture %s: %s", capture.id, exc)
            return Response(
                {"detail": "Invalid receipt line mapping."},
                status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
            )

        capture.refresh_from_db()
        output = GroceryReceiptCaptureSerializer(
            capture,
            context=self.get_serializer_context(),
        )
        return Response({"result": result, "receipt_capture": output.data})

def _apply_pantry_quantity(
    pantry: PantryItemState,
    new_qty: int,
    now: Any,
    user: Any,
) -> list[str]:
    """Set pantry quantity, auto-marking out at 0 or clearing out on re-stock.

    Returns the list of model fields touched (for save(update_fields=...))."""
    pantry.quantity = new_qty
    pantry.last_signal_at = now
    touched = ["quantity", "last_signal_at"]
    if new_qty == 0:
        pantry.marked_out_at = now
        pantry.marked_out_by = user
        touched.extend(["marked_out_at", "marked_out_by"])
    elif pantry.marked_out_at is not None:
        pantry.marked_out_at = None
        pantry.marked_out_by = None
        pantry.base_confidence = max(pantry.base_confidence, 1.0)
        touched.extend(["marked_out_at", "marked_out_by", "base_confidence"])
    return touched


class PantryItemStateViewSet(
    FeatureRequiredMixin, viewsets.ModelViewSet[PantryItemState]
):
    """Read and correct advisory pantry confidence for family products."""

    required_feature = "groceries"
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]
    serializer_class = PantryItemStateSerializer
    http_method_names = ["get", "patch", "head", "options"]
    pagination_class = None

    def get_serializer_context(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        context = dict(super().get_serializer_context())
        context["timezone_name"] = _request_timezone_name(self.request.user)
        return context

    def get_queryset(self) -> Any:
        family_ids = _accessible_family_ids(self.request.user)
        if not family_ids:
            return PantryItemState.objects.none()

        queryset = PantryItemState.objects.filter(family_id__in=family_ids)
        family_id = self.request.query_params.get("family")
        if family_id:
            try:
                queryset = queryset.filter(family_id=UUID(family_id))
            except ValueError:
                return queryset.none()

        query = self.request.query_params.get("q")
        if query:
            queryset = queryset.filter(
                product_preference__product_name__icontains=query
            )

        return queryset.select_related(
            "family",
            "product_preference",
            "product_preference__grocery_category",
            "source_receipt_line",
            "marked_out_by",
        )

    def list(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        queryset = list(self.filter_queryset(self.get_queryset()))
        requested_state = request.query_params.get("state")
        if requested_state:
            timezone_name = _request_timezone_name(request.user)
            queryset = [
                pantry
                for pantry in queryset
                if PantryConfidenceService.describe_state(
                    pantry,
                    timezone_name=timezone_name,
                )["state"]
                == requested_state
            ]
        serializer = self.get_serializer(queryset, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)

    def partial_update(self, request: Any, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        pantry = self.get_object()
        serializer = PantryCorrectionSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        correction = serializer.validated_data["correction"]
        notes = serializer.validated_data.get("notes")
        requested_quantity = serializer.validated_data.get("quantity")
        now = timezone.now()
        update_fields = ["updated_at"]

        if correction == "out":
            pantry.marked_out_at = now
            pantry.marked_out_by = request.user
            pantry.quantity = 0
            update_fields.extend(["marked_out_at", "marked_out_by", "quantity"])
        elif correction == "have":
            pantry.base_confidence = 1.0
            pantry.last_signal_at = now
            pantry.purchased_on = timezone.localdate(
                now,
                timezone=resolve_pantry_timezone(_request_timezone_name(request.user)),
            )
            pantry.marked_out_at = None
            pantry.marked_out_by = None
            pantry.quantity = (
                requested_quantity if requested_quantity is not None else 1
            )
            update_fields.extend(
                [
                    "base_confidence",
                    "last_signal_at",
                    "purchased_on",
                    "marked_out_at",
                    "marked_out_by",
                    "quantity",
                ]
            )
        elif correction == "set_quantity":
            new_qty = requested_quantity if requested_quantity is not None else 0
            update_fields.extend(
                _apply_pantry_quantity(pantry, new_qty, now, request.user)
            )
        elif correction in ("increment", "decrement"):
            delta = requested_quantity if requested_quantity is not None else 1
            if correction == "decrement":
                delta = -delta
            new_qty = max(0, pantry.quantity + delta)
            update_fields.extend(
                _apply_pantry_quantity(pantry, new_qty, now, request.user)
            )
        else:
            pantry.base_confidence = 0.0
            pantry.last_signal_at = now
            pantry.marked_out_at = None
            pantry.marked_out_by = None
            update_fields.extend(
                [
                    "base_confidence",
                    "last_signal_at",
                    "marked_out_at",
                    "marked_out_by",
                ]
            )

        if notes is not None:
            pantry.notes = notes
            update_fields.append("notes")

        pantry.save(update_fields=update_fields)
        return Response(self.get_serializer(pantry).data)

class CouponScreenshotUploadView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    Upload a coupon screenshot for AI-based OCR extraction.

    POST /api/groceries/lists/{run_id}/coupon-screenshots/
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request: Any, run_id: Any) -> Any:
        # Verify family access
        try:
            grocery_run = GroceryList.objects.get(id=run_id)
        except GroceryList.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Grocery list not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user, family=grocery_run.family, is_active=True
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        serializer = CouponUploadSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        with transaction.atomic():
            capture = GroceryCouponCapture.objects.create(
                grocery_run=grocery_run,
                uploaded_by=request.user,
                photo_url=serializer.validated_data["photo_url"],
                s3_object_key=serializer.validated_data["s3_object_key"],
                parse_status="pending",
            )

        # Queue Celery task after transaction commits
        def queue_task() -> None:
            from .tasks import process_coupon_screenshot

            process_coupon_screenshot.delay(str(capture.id))

        transaction.on_commit(queue_task)

        logger.info(
            "Created coupon capture %s for run %s by user %s",
            capture.id,
            run_id,
            request.user.id,
        )

        response_serializer = GroceryCouponCaptureSerializer(capture)
        return Response(response_serializer.data, status=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

class CouponLineResolveView(FeatureRequiredMixin, APIView):
    required_feature = "groceries"

    """
    Resolve matches for a coupon line by creating GroceryItems.

    POST /api/groceries/coupon-lines/{line_id}/resolve-matches/
    """

    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request: Any, line_id: Any) -> Any:
        try:
            line = GroceryCouponLine.objects.select_related(
                "coupon_capture__grocery_run__family"
            ).get(id=line_id)
        except GroceryCouponLine.DoesNotExist:
            return Response(
                {"error": "Coupon line not found"},
                status=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
            )

        grocery_run = line.coupon_capture.grocery_run

        if not FamilyMembership.objects.filter(
            user=request.user, family=grocery_run.family, is_active=True
        ).exists():
            return Response(
                {"error": "You are not a member of this family"},
                status=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
            )

        serializer = ResolveMatchesSerializer(data=request.data)
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)

        selected_ids = serializer.validated_data["selected_candidate_ids"]
        planned_store_id = serializer.validated_data.get("planned_store_id")
        quantity = serializer.validated_data.get("quantity", 1)
        unit = serializer.validated_data.get("unit", "count")

        created_items = []
        duplicate_warnings = []
        requested_store = None

        if planned_store_id:
            requested_store = GroceryStore.objects.filter(
                id=planned_store_id,
                family=grocery_run.family,
                is_active=True,
            ).first()
            if requested_store is None:
                return Response(
                    {"error": "Planned store not found for this family"},
                    status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                )

        with transaction.atomic():
            candidates = GroceryCouponCandidate.objects.filter(
                id__in=selected_ids, coupon_line=line
            )

            for candidate in candidates:
                # Check for duplicates
                from .services import (
                    CouponScreenshotProcessorService,
                    GroceryStoreResolverService,
                )

                existing = CouponScreenshotProcessorService.check_duplicate_item(
                    grocery_run, candidate.display_name
                )
                if existing:
                    duplicate_warnings.append(
                        f"'{candidate.display_name}' already exists in the list"
                    )

                # Store precedence:
                # 1) explicit planned_store_id from request
                # 2) existing duplicate item's planned store
                # 3) inferred by detected coupon/candidate store name (existing aliases only)
                item_store = requested_store
                if item_store is None and existing and existing.planned_store_id:
                    item_store = existing.planned_store
                if item_store is None:
                    detected_store = candidate.store_name or line.store_name
                    if detected_store:
                        item_store = GroceryStoreResolverService.resolve_store(
                            family=grocery_run.family,
                            raw_name=detected_store,
                        )

                # Idempotent: get_or_create resolution
                resolution, created = GroceryCouponLineResolution.objects.get_or_create(
                    coupon_line=line,
                    candidate=candidate,
                    defaults={
                        "created_by": request.user,
                    },
                )

                # Only create GroceryItem if resolution was just created
                if created:
                    item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
                        grocery_list=grocery_run,
                        name=candidate.display_name,
                        quantity=quantity,
                        unit=unit,
                        planned_store=item_store,
                        created_by=request.user,
                    )
                    resolution.linked_item = item
                    resolution.save(update_fields=["linked_item"])
                    created_items.append(item)

            # Update line status
            total_candidates = line.candidates.count()
            resolved_count = line.resolutions.count()
            if resolved_count >= total_candidates:
                line.line_status = "resolved"
            elif resolved_count > 0:
                line.line_status = "partially_resolved"
            line.save(update_fields=["line_status"])

        items_serializer = GroceryItemSerializer(
            created_items, many=True, context={"request": request}
        )
        return Response(
            {
                "line_status": line.line_status,
                "created_items": items_serializer.data,
                "duplicate_warnings": duplicate_warnings,
            }
        )
